hazard_classes.1: Low hazard: 0.2 m < maximum depth < 0.5 m and depth x velocity < 0.5 sqm/s
hazard_classes.2: Medium hazard: 0.5 m < maximum depth < 1.5 m or depth x velocity 0.5-1.5 sqm/s
hazard_classes.3: High hazard: maximum depth > 1.5 m or depth x velocity > 1.5 sqm/s
